jobs.title: Lab Software Application Specialist - temporary 12 months
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Lab Software Application Specialis is responsible for the translation, modification, maintenance, and verification of methods and report templates (Master Data) for Labware LIMS 7 and Chromeleon 7.3.2.. The main duty falls in the roll out phase in the course of upgrading from Chromeleon 7.2.10 to 7.3.2. This position is limited for 1 year.

Responsibilities

Method & Template Migration

Translate existing Chromeleon objects from version 7.2.10 into 7.3.2
Maintain LIMS Master Data
Assess legacy configurations and identify required adaptations
Ensure functional equivalence and data integrity
Execute controlled migration including testing
Support migration within the upgrade program

Template Build & Maintenance

Create, modify, and maintain Chromeleon templates
Ensure harmonization across laboratories
Maintain template libraries and documentation
Perform regular reviews for compliance and consistency
Optimize templates for usability and efficiency

Validation & Documentation

Support validation of templates and methods
Author and review validation documentation
Execute test cases and document results
Support deviation handling

Change Control & Governance

Process changes under formal change control
Perform impact and risk assessments
Ensure alignment with SOPs and governance
Support documentation updates

Operational Support & SME Role

Serve as SME for Chromeleon templates
Support troubleshooting
Collaborate with QA, IT, SMEs
Support training of end users

Qualifications

Degree in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field.
Experience with Chromeleon CDS
Experience in method configuration and reporting
Experience in system migrations preferred
Exposure to CSV in GxP environments
Strong CDS and chromatography knowledge
Understanding of GxP and data integrity
Knowledge of change control
Ability to translate analytical workflows into system configurations
Analytical and problem-solving mindset
High attention to detail

jobs.title: Internship: Software Application Developer - Cryptographic Validation System (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
You will be part of the Competence Center Cryptography & Security which is in charge of supporting all NXP business lines on cybersecurity for the entire NXP product portfolio. You will work in a distributed team to analyze, extract and implement a set of requirements in view of automatization of a test framework for the validation of cryptographic implementations.

Your Responsibilities

Developing new features for an existing web application
Defining and implementing a validation concept for the application

Your profile

Student in SW development, information science, information and computer engineering or similar
Strong software development skills with proven experience in Java, Java Script as well as C
Independent working style, willingness to learn, listen and adapt
Problem solving skills
Good English level spoken and written is required
Work with an international multi-site team
Good communication skills
Self-organized and good level of autonomy
Basic understanding of cryptographic algorithms would be an asset
Available for at least 16 hours per week, duration over 6 months

Please note: The successful candidate may/will be responsible for security related tasks. The assignment may/will be in scope of security certifications, therefore a conscious and reliable way of working is necessary.
